explanations.3: This environment variable tells the package installer to skip interactive prompts, so the Docker build won't get stuck waiting for user input.
explanations.11: After installing packages, we delete the package manager's cache files to reduce the Docker image size.
explanations.15: The empty string `""` is a placeholder for the script's first argument; the real arguments (`--unattended --keep-zshrc`) start after it.
explanations.25: The `-q` flag means "quiet" (less output), and `-b main` sets the default branch name to `main` instead of the older `master`.
explanations.31: This sets the default starting directory when someone enters the container, so they land deep in a folder tree that demonstrates zsh's navigation features.
explanations.37: The `-i` flag makes the shell interactive (accepting commands), and `-l` makes it a login shell (loading configuration files like .zshrc).
